Mar 22
CA San Lorenzo de Almagro: SAF decided to deduct 6 points at the end of the championship.
Apr 8
CA Huracán: SAF decided to deduct 6 points at the end of the championship.
Jun 10
CA San Lorenzo de Almagro: SAF decided to suspend conditionally the sanction of Mar 22.
CA Huracán: SAF decided to suspend conditionally the sanction of Apr 8.

Note.
To be defined:
CA Talleres qualified for the 2020 Copa Sudamericana in accordance with the literal regulations:
Best team in Superliga 2018/2019 not previously qualified if Copa de la Superliga was not approved until November 30, 2018.
AA Argentinos Juniors qualified for the 2020 Copa Sudamericana in accordance with the spirit of what SAF wanted to regulate:
Best team in Copa de la Superliga not previously qualified.
Copa de Superliga was approved on December 12, 2018.
